Container.Name: tastearr
Container.Overview: Tastearr learns your anime taste from Sonarr, Radarr, Plex/Jellyfin watch history, your AniList/MAL list or a quick quiz, then ranks each new season's anime for you: continuing shows, new shows, shorts and movies, a weekly schedule that fills your light days, and where each show streams. Add picks to Sonarr/Radarr in one click, or just follow shows and get "episode is out" alerts on your phone (ntfy, Gotify, Discord).
Container.Changes: ### 0.6.0 - Auto-add (off by default): picks above a match % go to Sonarr/Radarr by themselves, with a cap and a preview - Sonarr/Radarr Custom List import lists, System health, password-protected backup, /ping - New seasons of owned shows matched through the earlier season; "Get the new season" with a season choice - Faster first-run quiz, phone-friendly layout, "My streaming services"

Config.Name: Sonarr config folder (optional, read-only)
Config.Description: Optional. Point at Sonarr's appdata folder (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/sonarr) so Tastearr can read its API key during setup. You can remove it afterwards.

Config.Name: Radarr config folder (optional, read-only)
Config.Description: Optional. Point at Radarr's appdata folder so Tastearr can read its API key during setup.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: Optional. If you use a reverse proxy, set its IP or subnet (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16) so client IPs are read correctly. Never 'true'.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your time zone, e.g. America/Toronto (Unraid fills this in automatically)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for files Tastearr writes in /config
